sources.heading: DUPR Submission & Eligibility
sources.content:
5.7. DUPR Submission & Eligibility: All qualifying games will be automatically entered into
the DUPR rating system. Games that are forfeited, incomplete, or deemed ineligible will
not be recorded in DUPR (unless otherwise specified by a rule). Individuals/Players are
not authorized to independently submit any Club League scheduled games to DUPR.

sources.content:
6.1.9.7. The Picklebreaker™ shall be played only when the match is tied 2–2
following completion of all preceding rounds. The Picklebreaker™ features the
designated doubles teams that participated in the preceding rounds, rotating
in accordance with the Picklebreaker™ Rotation Rules. The Picklebreaker™
shall consist of one game to 15 points, win by two (2), using Rally Scoring.
Note: Picklebreaker matches will not be recorded in DUPR and do not reflect
on individual’s W/L record.

6.2.3.6. DUPR Posting: All gender-based games will be submitted and posted to the
DUPR system. Mixed doubles games and any Picklebreaker™ games will not be
submitted or posted to DUPR.
Teams are numbered 1–3 for Men’s Doubles, 4–6 for Women’s Doubles, and 7–12 for Mixed
Doubles. These team numbers correspond directly to the Match Score Sheet printed from the system.
We highly recommend assigning higher team numbers to teams with higher combined skill levels and
ratings (for instance, Team 6 should have a higher combined DUPR rating than Team 4 in Women’s or
Team 12 should be a higher team rating than Team 7 in Mixed Doubles).

sources.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
sources.heading: Saturday DUPR League Match Day Format
sources.content:
Saturday DUPR League Match Day Format
The schedule uses two courts for men’s teams and two courts for women’s teams. After the first four
gender-doubles rounds, Men’s Team 3 and Women’s Team 6 play while Mixed Teams 7 and 8 begin.
Round 6 includes the remaining mixed teams. If the match is tied 12-12 after all gender and mixed
doubles, the Picklebreaker is played on two courts using the same mixed teams in the captains’
designated order.

sources.title: LWR Pickleball Club DUPR League Rules
sources.heading: Scoring
sources.content:
6.2.4. Scoring: A maximum of 27 total possible match points per date. This includes 24
possible points awarded during standard play, plus a 3-point bonus. If the match
ends in a tie after the mixed doubles division (12-12), a Picklebreaker will be played
to determine the winner of the 3 bonus points. If there is no tie, the leading team
automatically receives the 3-point bonus.

6.2.5. Player Cap: Every player plays 3 gender double games to 15 and will then play 1
mixed game to 15. Optional lineups may include players who compete only in
gender doubles or only in mixed doubles. Depending on the outcome, the 6 mixed
teams will then play the Picklebreaker sequence playing up to 4+ points per team.

scope.content:
6.2. Saturday DUPR League
The Saturday DUPR League is designed for players who prefer weekend competition or are
unable to participate during the week. This coed league features community-based teams
made up of both men and women, competing every other Saturday in a unique format that
includes men's doubles, women's doubles, mixed doubles and the exciting mixed doubles
Picklebreaker to determine tied matches. Teams are grouped into divisions based on
combined DUPR ratings, creating competitive and enjoyable matches while fostering
camaraderie and community spirit throughout the Lakewood Ranch area.
